findings.detail: The v3 manifest validates as a strict evidence-changing release with exactly two UPDATE records, no binding claims, no legal interpretation and no contract change. Deterministic integration reproduces the exact candidate with two writes.
The proposal-local evidence review is EVIDENCE_READY and is bound to the exact evidence-lock hash. Its reviewer is distinct from both the release author and this independent release reviewer.
The locked receipt resolves 21 of 21 references and 9 of 9 section bindings with no resolver findings. The locked receipt hash matches the evidence-lock entry.
The future-vault overlay validates with zero errors; both stable note IDs, section bindings, paths and semantic Obsidian links resolve against the proposal overlay combined with the active vault.

SRC-0035 is framework material, SRC-0036 and SRC-0038 are qualified supervisory guidance, and SRC-0046 is bounded MITRE ATLAS dataset context. The proposed notes preserve non-binding scope and introduce no obligation, prohibition, legal interpretation, prevalence claim or universal control claim.
The two SRC-0035 visual-review candidates for Pages 5 and 9 remain outside the evidence lock and are not used by any of the nine section bindings.
This verdict establishes readiness for human approval only; it does not approve or integrate the candidate.
